Title: General availability: Azure CNI powered by Cilium

Body.Content:
Azure CNI powered by Cilium in now generally available. Azure CNI powered by Cilium is a comprehensive networking solution that combines the control plane of Azure CNI with the dataplane capabilities of Cilium. With faster service routing, enhanced security options, eBPF technology, and compatibility with Overlay mode and Pod subnet mode, it empowers AKS clusters with improved performance, stronger security, and better insights into in-cluster traffic flow.

Learn more.
